definitions: Relating to a task where a model must generalize to unseen classes or tasks without any specific training examples for those classes or tasks.
Pertaining to the ability of an AI model to perform a task it has not been explicitly trained on, by leveraging prior knowledge.
examples: The model demonstrated impressive zero-shot learning capabilities.
We evaluated its performance on a zero-shot classification task.
Zero-shot generalization is a key challenge in AI.
